rationale: M0 covers P0, P1 and T5 at 4 T each (12 T), with both pairs as via-ancilla temporary ANDs and T5 as a Jones Toffoli. T0/T9 and T2/T7 see the same control values at both ends, because g1/g16 and g4/g11 cancel. So each can be a via-ancilla temporary AND (4 T per pair), and T4 is a Jones Toffoli, for 24 T total versus the 32 T all-Jones baseline.
